newsitem.title: USA: CP&L sees S.C. nuke up fully by weekend.
newsitem.headline: CP&L sees S.C. nuke up fully by weekend.

text.p: Carolina Power & Light Co (CP&L) said Monday its 683 megawatt (MW) Robinson nuclear power unit 2 would reach full output by the end of the week after a brief automatic trip Sunday.
"On Sunday, it went online. We're at 20 to 30 power," a CP&L spokesman said.
"It'll take a few days," he said when asked about the schedule of Robinson 2 returning to 100 percent power.
Before the Hartsville, S.C., station could produce at 100 percent capacity, technicians planned to test the unit at various output levels, the spokesman added.
The Sunday outage, caused by a valve failure, occurred during startup from a refueling and maintenance outage that began September 7.
CP&L is the operator and sole owner of the Robinson 2 reactor.
